excerpt: Compare Dubai and Ajman property investments using the complete purchase cost, ownership eligibility, owner expenses and net rental assumptions.
introduction:
A Dubai versus Ajman investment comparison should begin with two actual properties and the same definition of total cost. Add the price, registration, brokerage, finance and initial work, then estimate rent after vacancy and owner expenses. The cheapest headline price is not necessarily the lowest total cost or the best fit for your plans.

The examples below show how to compare acquisition costs using the same method. The examples provide a framework for comparing purchase costs across the two emirates.
takeaways: Verify your ownership right and obtain an itemised current quote for the exact property in each emirate.
Compare full acquisition cost and net operating income using the same period and expense categories.
Allow for building condition, finance, vacancy and eventual sale costs as well as the purchase price.

sections.heading: What does total purchase cost include?
sections.body:
Add the agreed price, buyer-paid registration and brokerage, applicable tax on services, any lender charges, inspection, repairs and furnishing. Keep a separate reserve for unexpected work or vacancy. Ask for written figures and confirm who pays each item.

For a completed Dubai property, DLD's [sale registration service](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/property-sale-registration/) lists 2% of the sale value for each party, plus other charges. The agreement can allocate the total differently. Ajman's [sale registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3162) lists its process and different fee categories; ask the department to clarify the current amount for the exact unit and buyer.

Do not apply one emirate's fee schedule to the other or assume the full cost from an advertised price. The [Dubai upfront cost guide](/journal/total-upfront-cost-of-buying-property-in-dubai) and [Ajman buying cost guide](/journal/total-cost-of-buying-an-apartment-in-ajman) explain the separate calculations.

sections.heading: A sample cost comparison
sections.body:
Assume a sample Dubai apartment has a price of AED 1,000,000 and AED 55,000 of combined acquisition and setup costs, for a total of AED 1,055,000. Assume a sample Ajman apartment has a price of AED 650,000 and AED 30,000 of combined costs, for a total of AED 680,000. The difference is AED 375,000 in this example.

The two example homes differ in location, size, condition and tenant appeal. The example uses the same method for both locations so each cost can be compared consistently. The chart shows total entry cost before a separate contingency reserve.

Replace every input with an actual offer and current authority, broker, lender and repair quotes. Compare entry costs alongside rental income, vacancy and annual owner expenses.

sections.heading: Verify eligibility and documents
sections.body:
Ask the relevant department to confirm the right available to your nationality for the exact unit. In Dubai, DLD's [FAQs](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/frequently-asked-questions) describe registration for non-UAE citizens in designated areas. In Ajman, verify the current project and buyer position with the land department; an older list of projects is not a substitute for a current confirmation.

Review title or initial registration, seller authority, developer clearance, any mortgage and an existing tenancy. For off-plan, check the project registration, contract, payment recipient, construction status and handover provisions. Keep receipts and the registered outcome.

If a representative will act for you, confirm the scope and validity of their authority and the documents required by the relevant service.

sections.heading: Compare net income and finance separately
sections.body:
Use recent signed leases for similar apartments in each building. Subtract a vacancy allowance and owner-paid service charges, management, repairs and insurance from expected rent. Divide by full acquisition cost to compare net operating yield. The [Dubai net yield guide](/journal/how-to-calculate-net-rental-yield-in-dubai) and [Ajman net yield guide](/journal/how-to-calculate-net-rental-yield-in-ajman) use the same principle.

If borrowing, prepare a separate repayment and cash-flow schedule. Compare lender fees, valuation, insurance and the remaining loan at sale; the loan offered for one property may differ from another. Do not present unleveraged operating yield as cash received after mortgage payments.

Test lower rent, longer vacancy and a major repair. A property should remain manageable without relying on a guaranteed tenant or resale gain.

sections.heading: Compare the building and the exit
sections.body:
Visit each unit and its common areas, check transport and services for the intended tenant, and request current service-charge and maintenance information. The [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) and [Dubai Hills and Creek Harbour guide](/journal/dubai-hills-estate-vs-dubai-creek-harbour-for-families) provide location context, but individual buildings vary.

Seek recent completed sales of similar properties where evidence is available. Consider the time to sell, selling costs and any loan settlement. Use the emirate-wide total for context and compare completed sales for similar apartments.

Use the same holding period and risk assumptions where possible, and state what remains uncertain. A higher projected yield can accompany a different level of capital, management effort or resale risk.

sections.heading: Plan the timing of each payment
sections.body:
A cash buyer and a financed buyer may face different payment dates even when the purchase price is the same. Record the deposit, transfer charges, lender disbursement and any remaining instalments on a single calendar for each property. Check the refund conditions and whether a deposit is credited towards the price.

For an off-plan home, include the cost of your existing accommodation until the unit is ready and allow for a possible delay. For a ready rental investment, include the time and work needed before a tenant moves in. Compare the cash reserve left after each payment rather than only the total on paper.

sections.heading: Request current property details
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Dubai projects](/projects?emirate=Dubai) and [Ajman projects](/projects?emirate=Ajman). [Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget, nationality and intended use, and ask which specific units are currently available.

Request written terms and verify the ownership right and official charges in the relevant emirate before making a commitment.
